about: Findings already judged in a QA pass doc (D47): walk_parallel.py marks a finding that matches a rule (every field given is a case-insensitive regex over the finding's field) and leaves it out of the theme's triage.md; it stays in report.json. '*' applies to every theme. Add a rule only for a finding a pass doc judged with a reason, and name that doc; remove it when the reason no longer holds.

*.why: the wallpaper's Choose… opens the system's file chooser, which the walker can't see
the Play on panel's own tab: pressing it redraws the panel in place
jellyfin-web asks whether the user may edit a playlist; the walker users aren't its owner and the server answers 404

jellyfin-web's own classic home: its book cards
the Audio test's Play buttons pressed while a clip plays, when they are busy
two controls for one person (artist and album artist): Back focuses the other
the start strip's rows are not levels: the mouse's Back button goes back in history (the app's mapping, as on every page)
a library's pivot is a view choice, not a level: the mouse's Back button goes back in history

jellyfin-web's own profile page logs it as it opens, under any theme; the stock control logs it on Profile in every run
